```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)  # for color functions
library(RColorBrewer)
```

## Read in metabolite data
We'll be making two subplots here: one version with abx only information, and 
the other with all the comparisons from published literature. The 3 month group 
data will still be shown so it's easier to compare direction. 

```{r read.data}
metab_betas = read.csv("../data/metabolite_abx_regressions_betas.csv")
q_values = read.csv("../data/metabolite_abx_regressions_qs.csv")

rownames(metab_betas) = metab_betas$plot_name
metab_betas$plot_name <- NULL

rownames(q_values) = q_values$plot_name
q_values$plot_name <- NULL

metabs_sorted <- metab_betas[order(metab_betas[, "abx_three"], decreasing = TRUE), ]
```

```{r rename.cols}
rename_vec <-  c(
    abx_three = "0 - 3 mo.",
    abx_twelve = "3 - 12 mo.",
    sol_beta_three   = "0 - 3 mo. (s)",
    sol_beta_six  = "3 - 6 mo.",
    beta_binary = "Any abx/5y.",
    beta_total = "Total/5 y."
  )

colnames(metabs_sorted) <- dplyr::recode(colnames(metabs_sorted), !!!rename_vec)
#metabs_sorted <- dplyr::rename_with(metabs_sorted, ~ rename_vec[.x], .cols = everything())
```

## Create abx subplot

```{r p.val.fxn}
# Significance annotation logic
stars <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("")
  if (p < 0.001) return("***")
  if (p < 0.01)  return("**")
  if (p < 0.05)  return("*")
  if (p < 0.1)  return("#")
  return("")
}

# This is for use with Yousri 2021 later
stars_bonf <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("")
  if (p < 6.05e-5) return("*")
  return("")
}
```

### Create annotations
```{r}
sub_pathway <- metabs_sorted$SUB_PATHWAY

# Unique categories
unique_categories <- unique(sub_pathway)

# Assign colors from Paired palette (up to 12 colors)
palette <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Paired"))(15)
#category_colors <- setNames(palette[1:length(unique_categories)], unique_categories)

category_colors <- c(
  "Benzoate Metabolism" = "#A6CEE3",
  "Food Component/Plant" = "#3B8ABE", 
  "Secondary Bile Acid Metabolism" = "#B15928",
  "Fatty Acid Metabolism (Acyl Carnitine, Short Chain)" = "#72B29C",
  "Fatty Acid, Monohydroxy" = "#84C868",
  "Fatty Acid, Dicarboxylate" = "#4F9F3B",
  "Androgenic Steroids" = "#EEDB80" ,
  "Leucine, Isoleucine and Valine Metabolism" = "#EC9A91",
  "Tyrosine Metabolism" = "#E93E3F",
  "Tryptophan Metabolism" = "#F06C45",
  "Phenylalanine Metabolism" = "#FDAC4F",
  "Histidine Metabolism" = "#FB820F",
  "Glutathione Metabolism" =  "#D1AAB7",
  "Methionine, Cysteine, SAM and Taurine Metabolism" = "#8C66AF",
  "Unknown" = "#A99099"
)

gene_microbe_colors <- c(
  'Genetics' = 'black',
  'Microbiome' = '#dbb17c',
  'Hybrid' = '#7a5321',
  'N/A' = '#FAEBD7')

row_anno <- rowAnnotation(
  SUB_PATHWAY = sub_pathway,
  Determinant_Association = metabs_sorted$Determinant_Association,
  col = list(
    SUB_PATHWAY = category_colors,
    Determinant_Association = gene_microbe_colors),
  simple_anno_size = unit(3, "mm"),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  gp = gpar(col = "#808080", lwd = 0.15)
)

```


### Plot
```{r subset.cols}
cols <- c("0 - 3 mo.", "3 - 12 mo.", "0 - 3 mo. (s)", "3 - 6 mo.", "Any abx/5y.", "Total/5 y.")
q_cols <- c("abx_three", "abx_twelve", "sol_q_three", "sol_q_six", "q_binary", "q_total")

abx_matrix <- as.matrix(metabs_sorted[, cols])
rownames(abx_matrix) <- rownames(metabs_sorted)

q_matrix <- as.matrix(q_values[, q_cols])
qval_mat <- q_matrix[rownames(abx_matrix), ]
```


```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
abx_col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-0.5, 0, 0.5), c("blue", "white", "red")) 
col_split = c("Arivale", "Arivale", "HCHS/SOL", "HCHS/SOL", "MetaCardis", "MetaCardis")

abx_ht <- Heatmap(abx_matrix,
                  name = "Beta coefficient",
                  col = abx_col_fun,
                  na_col = "#C0C0C0",
                  left_annotation = row_anno,
                  column_split = col_split,
                  column_names_rot = 45,
                  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                  column_gap = unit(2, "mm"),
                  cluster_rows = FALSE,
                  cluster_columns = FALSE,
                  show_row_names = TRUE, 
                  row_names_side = "left", 
                  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                  height = unit(nrow(abx_matrix) * 5, "mm"),
                  rect_gp = gpar(col ="#808080", lwd = 1), 
                  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
                     pval <- qval_mat[i, j]
                     star <- stars(pval)
                     grid.text(star, x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, col = "black"))}
                   )
abx_ht
```

Save subplot A below!

```{r}
pdf("../figures/metabs_abx_arivale_sol_metacardis.pdf", width = 10, height = 8)  # open a PDF device
plot(abx_ht)                                
dev.off()                                 
```

## Now make subplot for literature comparison

```{r read.data.lit.comp}
lit_metab_values = read.csv("../data/metabolite_literature_values.csv")
lit_q_values = read.csv("../data/metabolite_literature_qs.csv")

rownames(lit_metab_values) = lit_metab_values$plot_name
lit_metab_values$plot_name <- NULL

rownames(lit_q_values) = lit_q_values$plot_name
lit_q_values$plot_name <- NULL

colnames(lit_metab_values)
```


```{r subset.data}
lit_cols <- c(
  "abx_three", "blood_sugar_meds",
  "mc_t2dm_beta",
  "Qatari_t2d_beta",
  "IFG_OR", "IGT_OR", "CGI_T2D_OR",
  "li_t2dm_hr"
  )

lit_q_cols <- c(
  "abx_three", "blood_sugar_meds",
  "mc_t2dm_q",
  "Qatari_t2d_rawp",
  "IFG_p_adj", "IGT_p_adj", "CGI_T2D_p_adj",
  "li_t2dm_fdr"
  )
  
# Save the subpathway
lit_metab_values$SUB_PATHWAY[lit_metab_values$SUB_PATHWAY == ""] <- "Unknown"
sub_pathway_plot_b <- lit_metab_values$SUB_PATHWAY
sub_pathway_plot_b
```


```{r generate.matrices}
# These are the columns for which I did the analyses
my_cols <- c(
  "abx_three",
  "blood_sugar_meds",
  "mc_t2dm_beta"
)

# From published literature
beta_cols <- c("Qatari_t2d_beta")
or_cols <- c("IFG_OR", "IGT_OR", "CGI_T2D_OR")
hr_cols <- c("li_t2dm_hr")

# Generate matrices for the actual values
my_matrix <- as.matrix(lit_metab_values[, my_cols])
rownames(my_matrix) <- rownames(lit_metab_values)

beta_matrix <-  as.matrix(lit_metab_values[, beta_cols])
or_matrix   <- as.matrix(lit_metab_values[, or_cols])
hr_matrix   <- as.matrix(lit_metab_values[, hr_cols])

# Now for the p-vales (whether FDR or raw)
my_qs <- as.matrix(lit_q_values[, c("abx_three","blood_sugar_meds","mc_t2dm_q")])
rownames(my_qs) <- rownames(lit_metab_values)

beta_qs <- as.matrix(lit_q_values[, c("Qatari_t2d_rawp")])
or_qs   <- as.matrix(lit_q_values[, c("IFG_p_adj", "IGT_p_adj", "CGI_T2D_p_adj")])
hr_qs   <- as.matrix(lit_q_values[, c("li_t2dm_fdr")])
```

And plot!

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
beta_col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("blue", "white", "red")) 
or_col_fun   <- colorRamp2(c(0.5, 1, 2.5), c("#008080", "white", "#800000")) 
hr_col_fun   <- colorRamp2(c(0.8, 1, 1.2), c("#191970", "white", "#FF1493"))

# Define gaps (e.g., split by study)
my_split = c("Arivale", "Arivale", "MetaCardis")
beta_split = c("Qatari")
or_split = c("Swedish", "Swedish", "Swedish")
hr_split = c("SOL+")
```

```{r abx.v.t2d.direction}
abx_concordant_metabs <- c(
  "hippurate",
  "cinnamoylglycine",
  "3-phenylpropionate (hydrocinnamate)",
  "indolepropionate",
  "isoursodeoxycholate"
)

neither <- c("X - 15728", "X - 12544", "X - 12283","X - 17351", "X - 12216","X - 17335",
             "5-hydroxyhexanoate", "phenyllactate (PLA)","2-piperidinone",
             "3-(3-hydroxyphenyl)propionate","glutarate (C5-DC)",
             "hydantoin_5_propionate","5alpha-androstan-3beta,17alpha-diol disulfate",
             "4-hydroxyhippurate","acetylcarnitine-C2",
             "3-(4-hydroxyphenyl)lactate", "hydantoin-5-propionate"
             )

abx_concordance <- dplyr::case_when(
  rownames(my_matrix) %in% abx_concordant_metabs ~ "Concordant",
  rownames(my_matrix) %in% neither               ~ "Neither",
  TRUE                                           ~ "Discordant"
)

concordance_colors <- c(
  "Concordant" = "yellowgreen",
  "Discordant" = "black",
  "Neither" = "white"
)

is_sig <- function(p, thresh = 0.1) !is.na(p) & p < thresh
t2dm_sig_count <-
  is_sig(my_qs[,  "mc_t2dm_q"])                 +   # MetaCardis
  is_sig(beta_qs[, 1], thresh = 6.05e-5) +   # Qatari (Bonferroni)
  is_sig(or_qs[,  "IFG_p_adj"])                 +   # Swedish 1
  is_sig(or_qs[,  "IGT_p_adj"])                 +   # Swedish 2
  is_sig(or_qs[,  "CGI_T2D_p_adj"])             +   # Swedish 3
  is_sig(hr_qs[,  1])                               # SOL+

ord <- order(
  factor(abx_concordance, levels = c("Concordant", "Discordant")),
  -sign(my_matrix[, "abx_three"]),   # Postive on top
  -t2dm_sig_count,                   # within same sign: more sig. T2DM cohorts on top
  -my_matrix[, "abx_three"]          # final tie-breaker: actual value
)

# apply ord to all matrices
# Value matrices (drop = FALSE keeps single-column matrices as matrices)
my_matrix   <- my_matrix[ord, , drop = FALSE]
beta_matrix <- beta_matrix[ord, , drop = FALSE]
or_matrix   <- or_matrix[ord, , drop = FALSE]
hr_matrix   <- hr_matrix[ord, , drop = FALSE]

# q-value matrices
my_qs   <- my_qs[ord, , drop = FALSE]
beta_qs <- beta_qs[ord, , drop = FALSE]
or_qs   <- or_qs[ord, , drop = FALSE]
hr_qs   <- hr_qs[ord, , drop = FALSE]

# Annotation vectors
sub_pathway_plot_b <- sub_pathway_plot_b[ord]
abx_concordance    <- abx_concordance[ord]

# row annotation, colors/categories from subplot A
row_anno <- rowAnnotation(
  SUB_PATHWAY = sub_pathway_plot_b,
  `Abx recency concordance` = abx_concordance,
  col = list(
    SUB_PATHWAY = category_colors,
    `Abx recency concordance` = concordance_colors),
  simple_anno_size = unit(3, "mm"),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  gp = gpar(col = "#808080", lwd = 0.15)
)
```

```{r fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
my_ht <- Heatmap(my_matrix,
                  name = "Beta-coefficient",
                  col = beta_col_fun,
                  na_col = "#C0C0C0",
                  left_annotation = row_anno,
                  column_split = my_split,
                  column_names_rot = 45,
                  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                  column_gap = unit(2, "mm"),
                  cluster_rows = FALSE,
                  cluster_columns = FALSE,
                  show_row_names = TRUE, 
                  row_names_max_width = grid::unit(8, "cm"),
                  row_names_side = "left", 
                  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                  height = unit(nrow(my_matrix) * 5, "mm"),
                  rect_gp = gpar(col ="#808080", lwd = 1), 
                  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
                     pval <- my_qs[i, j]
                     star <- stars(pval)
                     grid.text(star, x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, col = "black"))
                     }
                   )

beta_ht <- Heatmap(beta_matrix,
                  name = "Beta coefficient",
                  col = beta_col_fun,
                  na_col = "#C0C0C0",
                  column_split = beta_split,
                  column_names_rot = 45,
                  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                  column_gap = unit(2, "mm"),
                  cluster_rows = FALSE,
                  cluster_columns = FALSE,
                  show_row_names = TRUE, 
                  row_names_side = "left", 
                  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                  height = unit(nrow(beta_matrix) * 5, "mm"),
                  rect_gp = gpar(col ="#808080", lwd = 1), 
                  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
                     pval <- beta_qs[i, j]
                     star <- stars_bonf(pval)
                     grid.text(star, x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, col = "black"))
                     }
                   )

or_ht <- Heatmap(or_matrix,
                  name = "Odds Ratio",
                  col = or_col_fun,
                  na_col = "#C0C0C0",
                  column_split = or_split,
                  column_names_rot = 45,
                  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                  column_gap = unit(2, "mm"),
                  cluster_rows = FALSE,
                  cluster_columns = FALSE,
                  show_row_names = TRUE, 
                  row_names_side = "left", 
                  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                  height = unit(nrow(beta_matrix) * 5, "mm"),
                  rect_gp = gpar(col ="#808080", lwd = 1), 
                  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
                     pval <- or_qs[i, j]
                     star <- stars(pval)
                     grid.text(star, x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, col = "black"))
                     }
                   )
hr_ht <- Heatmap(hr_matrix,
                  name = "Hazard Ratio",
                  col = hr_col_fun,
                  na_col = "#C0C0C0",
                  column_split = hr_split,
                  column_names_rot = 45,
                  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                  column_gap = unit(2, "mm"),
                  cluster_rows = FALSE,
                  cluster_columns = FALSE,
                  show_row_names = TRUE, 
                  row_names_side = "left", 
                  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                  height = unit(nrow(beta_matrix) * 5, "mm"),
                  rect_gp = gpar(col ="#808080", lwd = 1), 
                  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
                     pval <- hr_qs[i, j]
                     star <- stars(pval)
                     grid.text(star, x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, col = "black"))
                     }
                   )

lit_ht <- my_ht + beta_ht + or_ht + hr_ht
lit_ht
```

```{r}
pdf("../figures/metabs_in_t2d_literature.pdf",
    width = 12, height = 10)  # open a PDF device
plot(lit_ht)                                
dev.off()  
```
